name: roadmap3d
description: Animated 3D roadmaps from a JSON spec — layers, dependencies, one lit path. Renders an MP4, a GIF preview, a cover PNG and a 2D strip headlessly (three.js + Chromium + ffmpeg).

scripts.validate:examples: node src/cli.mjs validate examples/supply-chain/roadmap3d.json && node src/cli.mjs validate examples/critical-path/roadmap3d.json && node src/cli.mjs validate examples/deps/roadmap3d.json
